name: enrichlayer
label: Enrich Layer
description: Professional network data enrichment API — company profiles, person data, work emails, and more.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: You can obtain your API key from [Dashboard Settings](https://enrichlayer.com/dashboard/api-key/).
